primary.title: NPS retirement planning: Can investments in AIFs, REITs and InvITs help improve returns and diversify your portfolio?
primary.summary: NPS subscribers could benefit from greater exposure to AIFs, REITs and InvITs as pension funds explore alternative investments. SBI Pension Funds MD & CEO Pranay Ranjan Dwivedi explains the potential returns, suggested allocation and risks.
